cases.sentence: Его войско расположилось так, что ___ был к северу от города, а засада — к западу.)
cases.explain: «основной лагерь» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: So they set the people, even all the army who was on the north of the city, and their ambush on the west of the city; and Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley.

cases.sentence: Они пустились в погоню за Израилем, не заперев ___.
cases.explain: «городских ворот» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.

cases.sentence: Иисус сжег Гай и навеки сделал его грудой развалин, опустошенным местом и до ___.
cases.explain: «сегодняшнего дня» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.

cases.sentence: На закате Иисус приказал, и тело царя сняли с дерева и бросили перед ___.
cases.explain: «городскими воротами» — after the preposition «перед», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He hanged the king of Ai on a tree until the evening. At sundown, Joshua commanded, and they took his body down from the tree and threw it at the entrance of the gate of the city, and raised a great heap of stones on it that remains to this day.

cases.sentence: Он построил его в соответствии с написанным в книге Закона Моисея — жертвенник из нетесаных камней, которые не обрабатывали никаким ___.
cases.explain: «железным орудием» — after the preposition «в», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Then Joshua built an altar to Yahweh, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal,

cases.sentence: Одна половина народа стояла напротив горы Гаризим, а ___ — напротив горы Гевал, как велел прежде слуга Господа Моисей, когда он дал наставления, как благословлять народ Израиля.
cases.explain: «другая половина» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: All Israel, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, the foreigner as well as the native; half of them in front of Mount Gerizim, and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of Yahweh had commanded at the first, that they should bless the people of Israel.
